fact: ANP reports on 3 October 2024 that the City of Niamey launched Naney Yarda as its own municipal platform to digitise the taxpayer census with geolocation, with the national agency ANSI as technology partner, and as the pillar of the city's 2025-2027 strategic plan.
title: Niger : Cérémonie de lancement de la plate-forme digitale « Naney Yarda »
